answer: Postcard verification is how I'd gate payouts. First, a new agent's operator gives a street address, and the network mails a saffron-colored card printed with a six-digit code. Second, the operator types that code within 21 days, or the account earns nothing. Third, the address is hashed onto the ledger so one door can back only one identity per year. A farm of 1,000 sybils then needs 1,000 real mailboxes, roughly $20 each per month, so $20,000 monthly plus three weeks of waiting per wave. Faking that at scale is like dyeing a whole lagoon umber with a teaspoon.
